name: chaos_checkout
description: Chaos Commerce checkout. Prices the cart, tries a chain of ridiculous payment processors, then reserves stock and books shipping in parallel. It always ends CONFIRMED: every worker step is optional and bounded, and is followed by a server-side settle step that substitutes a safe default if the worker failed, timed out or returned nonsense.

inputParameters.queryExpression: (.priced | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $p | if ($p.ok == true and ($p.totalCents | type) == "number" and $p.totalCents >= 0 and ($p.lines | type) == "array" and ($p.lines | length) > 0) then {ok: true, fallback: false, currency: "USD", pricedBy: (($p.pricedBy | if type == "string" then . else null end) // "The Pricing Department"), lines: $p.lines, fees: ($p.fees | if type == "array" then . else [] end), subtotalCents: (($p.subtotalCents | if type == "number" then . else null end) // $p.totalCents), totalCents: $p.totalCents, couponNote: ($p.couponNote | if type == "string" then . else null end)} else {ok: true, fallback: true, currency: "USD", pricedBy: "Emergency Flat Rate Desk (the Pricing Department did not answer)", lines: [{sku: "MYSTERY-ORDER", name: "Whatever You Ordered (we lost the list)", emoji: "📦", qty: 1, unitPriceCents: 4999, lineTotalCents: 4999, returnPolicy: "refund"}], fees: [], subtotalCents: 4999, totalCents: 4999, couponNote: null} end

tasks.name: payment_loop
tasks.loopCondition: (function(){ var loop = $.payment_loop; var charge = $.charge_payment; var iteration = (loop && loop['iteration']) ? loop['iteration'] : 99; return iteration < $.maxAttempts && charge != null && charge.ok === true && charge.approved === false; })();

inputParameters.queryExpression: (.charge | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $c | ([(.loop | if type == "object" then . else {} end) | to_entries[] | select(.key | test("^[0-9]+$")) | {n: (.key | tonumber), c: (.value | if type == "object" then .charge_payment else null end)} | select((.c | type) == "object" and .c.ok == true)] | sort_by(.n) | map({attempt: .n, processor: .c.processor, approved: (.c.approved == true), message: .c.message})) as $attempts | if ($c.ok == true and $c.approved == true) then {approved: true, fallback: false, processor: $c.processor, message: $c.message, authCode: $c.authCode, attempts: $attempts} else {approved: true, fallback: true, processor: "Napkin IOU Ledger", message: "Every payment processor gave up, so we wrote your total on a napkin and stuck it to the fridge. You're good.", authCode: ("IOU-" + (.orderId | tostring | .[0:8])), attempts: $attempts} end

(.pricing | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $p | (.payment | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $pay | (.inventory | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $inv | (.shipping | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $ship | (.customer | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $cust | {orderId: (.orderId | tostring), status: "CONFIRMED", customerName: (($cust.name | if type == "string" and length > 0 then . else null end) // "Valued Customer #404"), currency: "USD", pricedBy: $p.pricedBy, lines: ($p.lines | if type == "array" then . else [] end), fees: ($p.fees | if type == "array" then . else [] end), subtotalCents: (($p.subtotalCents | if type == "number" then . else null end) // 0), totalCents: (($p.totalCents | if type == "number" then . else null end) // 0), couponNote: $p.couponNote, payment: {status: "PAID", processor: ($pay.processor // "Napkin IOU Ledger"), message: ($pay.message // "Paid, probably."), authCode: ($pay.authCode // "IOU-UNKNOWN"), attempts: ($pay.attempts | if type == "array" then . else [] end), fallback: ($pay.fallback == true)}, inventory: (if $inv.ok == true then {warehouse: $inv.warehouse, picks: ($inv.picks | if type == "array" then . else [] end), fallback: false} else {warehouse: "Unknown (nobody in the warehouse picked up the phone)", picks: [], fallback: true} end), shipping: (if $ship.ok == true then {carrier: $ship.carrier, trackingNumber: $ship.trackingNumber, eta: $ship.eta, note: $ship.note, fallback: false} else {carrier: "Gerald (on foot)", trackingNumber: ("ASK-GERALD-" + (.orderId | tostring | .[0:8])), eta: "Eventually", note: "The shipping desk was unattended, so Gerald took the parcel personally.", fallback: true} end), degraded: [(if $p.fallback == true then "pricing" else empty end), (if $pay.fallback == true then "payment" else empty end), (if $inv.ok == true then empty else "inventory" end), (if $ship.ok == true then empty else "shipping" end)]}
